commitMessage:
US-062 Fix the class name of the crew capacity action, and ship the Crew Leads group

Moved from the Pull Request of US-062 with Move to my Pull Request:
CrewCapacityBatch, not CrewCapacityBach.

The Crew Leads public group is in the sources now: I had created it by hand
in my org, so the first action failed wherever nobody had.
prTitle: US-062 Fix the crew capacity action
prBody:
The crew capacity action of US-062 named a class that does not exist (`CrewCapacityBach`).

I moved it to this Pull Request with **Move to my Pull Request** and fixed the class name. It keeps its id, and `movedFrom` says which Pull Request it comes from: once this one is deployed, the action runs from here only.

It also adds the **Crew Leads** public group as metadata (`groups/Helios_Crew_Leads.group-meta.xml`, listed in `manifest/package.xml`). I had created it by hand in my own org, which is why the first action failed in `integration`: with the group in the sources, `uat`, `preprod` and production get it from the deployment, before the actions run.

Story: US-062 in BACKLOG.md
nextStep: Review the moved action and the group file, merge it, and read both Deployment Actions comments. Lab 3.3 step 12.
